name: Strong-open cascade: 09:50, then 10:30/11:00/11:30 (one trade a day)
why: Same institutional open flow as strong_open; on days the open is quiet the flow often starts later in the morning (European close, delayed program orders), so re-checking at 10:30-11:30 catches it. (development copy for the 2026-10-16 pre-registered tests 1 and 5: data to 2026-03-19)
